name: Witch Hunter: Darkslayer's client tooltip shows the ranged-slot cast time the server uses (#11409)
contract: Darkslayer 804179 and its ranks 680256-680262 and 681203 are ranged-slot spells (SPELL_ATTR0_USES_RANGED_SLOT 0x2, Attributes 65554)
with CastingTimeIndex 16 (1500 ms) for rank 1, 5 (2000 ms) for rank 2 and 19 (2500 ms) for ranks 3 to 9. SpellInfo::CalcCastTime adds the
500 ms ranged preparation, so the server casts them in 2000, 2500 and 3000 ms before haste while the client's SpellCastTimes rows keep
1500, 2000 and 2500 ms; the report saw every rank cast 0.5 s longer than its tooltip. The client patch stream now publishes a Spell.dbc
row for every rank whose CastingTimeIndex points at the row with the server's time. The server's own cast time is unchanged. Stock Hunter
Steady Shot 34120 is not registered and receives no cast-time row.
